title: RAC D2-0007 Anchor Provider Declaration
description: Additive preregistration contract for RAC-PER-D2-0007 anchor providers. Captures provider identity, version/hash, configuration, coordinate convention, confidence handling, and permitted data exposure, plus the mandatory provenance class (template_derived vs model_derived). Declaration/validation surface only: no provider implementation is defined or implied by this schema. Declares only; nothing is armed or executed.

identity.description: Provider name, e.g. 'fixed-torso-template-v1' or a named segmentation model.

artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the provider artifact (template file or model weights) pinned at declaration time.

configuration.description: Complete provider parameter set; must be sufficient to reproduce the provider's outputs.

anchor_capabilities.description: Closed D2-0007 anchor capability vocabulary (docs/PREREGISTRATION_D2-0007.md section 3.1). Not a pose framework.

provenance_class.description: Mandatory provenance class. template_derived: deterministic declared template, reproducible from the freeze record. model_derived: learned model; weights hash and confidence handling are governed surrogate-side dependencies.

origin.description: Fixed coordinate origin for all anchor outputs.

axis_directions.description: Axis direction convention, e.g. 'x right, y down'.

normalization.description: Whether coordinates are absolute pixels or normalized to the crop extent.

threshold.description: Fixed confidence threshold; required for model_derived providers, optional for template_derived.

low_confidence_fallback.description: Fixed fallback behavior when provider confidence is below threshold.

confidence_exposed_downstream.description: Whether confidence values may cross stage boundaries; exposure is declared, not implicit.

crosses_stage_boundary.description: Whether any provider output may cross a stage boundary (screening -> optimization -> freeze).

exposed_fields.description: Exactly which anchor output fields may be exposed. Coordinates/masks only in the default configuration.

source_imagery_exposed.description: Source imagery never crosses stage boundaries; must remain false.

heldout_derived_statistics_exposed.description: No held-out-derived statistic may ever be exposed by a provider; must remain false.
